title: Dear Newcomer: This Is Lisbon
logline: Lisbon writes a wry letter to a newcomer opening a coffee stand, then turns the film toward the viewer and asks which city comes next.

scenes.action: Hold a warm dark typography card while Lisbon opens the letter.

subtitles.text:
Dear newcomer,
I wrote you from my street.

scenes.card_text:
LISBON, PORTUGAL
A LETTER BEFORE THE FIRST COFFEE

scenes.action: Hold on the Grunds title screen for a clean visual breath.

subtitles.text:
Licences, rivals, and one
very short week.

scenes.action: Type Lisbon into the city field, sign the licence, and submit it.

subtitles.text:
Type Lisbon. Sign the licence.
I re-dress the street.

scenes.action: Hold on the licence as Nicolau Lisboa, Hello Kristof, Seagull Method, Fábrica Coffee Roasters, and Dear Breakfast appear with the €4 matcha price and welcome line.

subtitles.text:
Lisbon welcomes your new coffee stand
with warm light and curious regulars.

Five independent cafés nearby.
Matcha latte, about €4.

scenes.action: Slowly orbit the generated Lisbon-style furniture around the LISBON road decal.

subtitles.text:
My name sits on the road.
Black-and-white calçada portuguesa paving.

Whitewash, azulejo blue,
terracotta, ochre: my palette.

scenes.action: Push in on the PRÍNCIPE REAL ticker and the euro-denominated prices.

subtitles.text:
The ticker says PRÍNCIPE REAL.
Every price is painted in euros.

scenes.action: Open the dawn commodity brief and pause over the choice on its news card.

subtitles.text:
At dawn, my commodity brief
asks for a decision.

scenes.action: Track patrons walking up and queueing beneath their Portuguese name tags.

subtitles.text:
Maria. Ana. Miguel. Sofia.
Curious regulars, with memory.

scenes.action: Cut to a warm dark midpoint card as Lisbon turns the letter toward the viewer.

subtitles.text:
Your city is next.
What will its street become?

scenes.action: Frame the rival stand across the street and settle on its barista, João.

subtitles.text:
Back on my street,
João runs the rival stand.

scenes.action: Hold on the euro till as the total ticks upward while the day races ahead.

subtitles.text: They choose where to buy.

The euro till ticks up;
the day runs fast.

scenes.action: Present the end-of-week GRUNDS — LISBON card with its printed city link.

subtitles.text:
My week ends on a card:
GRUNDS — LISBON, ?city=lisbon.

Same link, same seeded week,
for everyone.

scenes.action: Pan across the public lit-cities map and its six city cards.

subtitles.text:
Lisbon joins New York, London,
Tokyo, Lagos, and São Paulo.

scenes.action: Replace Lisbon with a different city in the link and let the newly generated street arrive.

subtitles.text:
Now type a different city.
Watch another street arrive.

Lisbon was my letter.
Now type your own.

scenes.action: Hold the warm dark end card with the city link and the lit-map invitation.

subtitles.text: grunds.trustfall.xyz/?city=yourcity
Every city typed joins the lit map.

scenes.card_text:
YOUR CITY
grunds.trustfall.xyz/?city=yourcity
Every city typed joins the lit map.

music: A wordless, warm acoustic instrumental with nylon-string guitar, soft percussion, and upright bass; it gains a small pulse at the midpoint, then thins to leave the final link and map line clear.
director_notes: 1. Let the licence and licence facts sit; this is where the letter earns trust. 2. Use the orbit as the slowest move, then cut briskly through brief, queue, rival, and till. 3. Treat the midpoint card as a gear change, and hold the final invitation for a full ten seconds.
